title: Pharmacy-Patient Reduction for Immunization Services Charges
content:
# Desk Training Module — The Pharmacy-Patient Reduction on Immunization Services Charges

**The rule the module teaches.** On the charge for a cash-paid Immunization Services dose, the pharmacy-patient reduction is **5 percent** where three or more prescription pickups and three or more prescription refills were recorded at Kestrel in the last 3 calendar months, **2 percent** where one or two pickups were recorded in that time, and nothing otherwise.

## Questions answered

**Which records decide the reduction?** The patient's prescription fill records under **Prescriptions**: the pickup entries and the refill entries recorded at Kestrel against the patient's prescriptions.

**What does "in the last 3 calendar months" cover?** Entries dated fewer than 3 whole calendar months before today. A whole calendar month has passed once the same day of the month is reached again, so an entry dated 2 months and 25 days ago is inside the window and one dated exactly 3 whole months ago is outside it.

**Do both counts matter for 5 percent?** Yes. The 5 percent rate needs three or more pickups **and** three or more refills in the window. Three or more pickups with fewer than three refills does not earn 5 percent, and since it is not one or two pickups either, it earns nothing.

**Do refills matter for 2 percent?** No. The 2 percent rate turns on one or two pickups in the window, whatever the number of refills.

## Truth table

| Pickups in the last 3 calendar months | Refills in the last 3 calendar months | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Three or more | Three or more | 5 percent |
| Three or more | Two or fewer | Nothing |
| One or two | Any number | 2 percent |
| None | Any number | Nothing |

## Casebook (hypothetical patients)

- Hypothetical patient A: four pickups and three refills in the window. Reduction **5 percent**.
- Hypothetical patient B: five pickups and one refill in the window. Reduction **nothing**.
- Hypothetical patient C: two pickups and no refills in the window. Reduction **2 percent**.
- Hypothetical patient D: no pickup in the window, six refills. Reduction **nothing**.
